user.title: Metiundo Smart Meter
user.description:
Connect your Metiundo account to Home Assistant. The integration provides access to one selected electricity metering point (cumulative grid import/export energy) via the Metiundo API.

If you enable cost statistics, the first tariff is also used for historical imports. Additional tariffs can be added later through Configure.

If you need help with the configuration have a look at the [documentation]({documentation_url}).

init.description: Customize how this integration operates. When cost statistics are enabled, saving a tariff adds or replaces the tariff for that month. Tariffs must start on the first day of a month.

init.title: Update API Endpoint
init.description:
Your device is using API version {api_version} which is deprecated. Please update to v2 for continued support and new features.

Click Submit to update your device to use the new API endpoint (v2). This will reload the integration.

init.title: Acknowledge Configuration Issue
init.description:
Some configuration options are missing or invalid. Please reconfigure the integration to ensure proper operation.

Click Submit to acknowledge this issue. You may need to reconfigure the integration if problems persist.
